ns2:course.label: Physical Properties of Wood
ns2:course.description: (NRES 236) Physical properties of wood and non-wood plant fiber materials, emphasizing the influence of anatomy, density, and moisture content on the dimensional stability of wood materials; wood-liquid relations; thermal, electrical, and acoustical properties of wood. The theory and practice of wood seasoning are studied. Offered in alternate years. Prerequisite: CHEM 102.
